title: Late Charge on a Deduction Schedule Reinstated by a Returned Remittance — Calculation
content:
**Schedule priced.** Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, the late charge priced here is the one on the deduction schedule named by the remittance return booked most recently on the agreement, when it is the only remittance return booked that day and the schedule carries no employer-liable shortfall notice; in any other case nothing is booked under this calculation.

**Open amount and period.** The open amount of the reinstated schedule is the schedule amount less the remittances and write-offs pointing to it, plus the remittance returns pointing to it, as the records stand on the day the charge is booked, and the late-charge period runs from the schedule's original due date.

**Charge.** The late charge on the reinstated schedule is the greater of the tier's minimum late charge and the percentage charge, which is the rate of the tier's late charge rate percent applied to that open amount and rounded half up to the cent.

**Order of the figures.** For a schedule a returned remittance reinstated, the figures are applied in one fixed order: percentage points added to the rate are added to it first, the rate so formed is applied to the open amount and rounded half up to the cent, and the way the late charge is worked out is then applied.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Enterprise-tier program: rate 1.25 percent, minimum 50.00)

- A schedule of 12600.00 whose remittance of 12600.00 was returned is open by 12600.00; the percentage charge is 157.50 and the late charge 157.50.
- A schedule of 2400.00 whose remittance was returned is open by 2400.00; the percentage charge is 30.00 and the late charge 50.00.
